title: Sundiata: The Lion Who Built Mali

scenes.caption: What if the child others dismissed was destined to become a great ruler? The epic of Sunjata tells of a boy whose early difficulties made others doubt him. His mother Sogolon endured ridicule, while rivals plotted around the court.

scenes.emotional_turn: a mocked child becomes the quiet center of a court threatened by rivalry
scenes.visual_evidence: Sogolon shields young Sunjata while court factions watch from layered palace spaces
